kjv: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.

lines.say: Before you close your eyes, hear this over your house.
lines.big: Before you close your eyes, hear this over your house

lines.say: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul. Psalm one twenty one, verse seven.
lines.big: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.

lines.say: All evil. Not some of it. He keeps your soul tonight.
lines.big: All evil. Not some of it. He keeps your soul tonight.

lines.say: Lord, preserve me and my family tonight from all evil. In Jesus' name, amen.
Want the Word playing while you sleep? Psalms 105 through 124, read slowly, is on our channel. The link is in the description.
